APIs.match_family: (*,registry,family_id,host,receptors,candidate_bindings,tick,limits=None) -> bounded matching packet; candidate_bindings iterable of COMPLETE substitution dicts; zero candidates/nonmatches never prove absence

descriptor_v2.call_hypotheses: ordered refs, must resolve to actual original Gamma occurrences; materialize real assumption primitives
descriptor_v2.call_substitution: exact child parameter map: VARIABLE={variable_id:parentVARIABLE}; PREDICATE_SYMBOL={literal:name}|{parameter:parentPRED}; TERM/FORMULA={formal_variables:[parentVARIABLE IDs],body:parent term/formula template}; no preencoded executable/native payload
descriptor_v2.dependencies: distinct exact family IDs actually called, acyclic entire supplied registry, no unused declared dependency
descriptor_v2.family_identity: sha256 canonical descriptor excluding only family_id and provenance, ensure_ascii=True sort_keys=True separators=(comma,colon); full preimage retained and compared
descriptor_v2.output_sources: may use any explicit reference; family-call output ID required even for one output
descriptor_v2.primitive_arguments: dict name->{type:FORMULA|TERM|VARIABLE|PREDICATE_SYMBOL|LITERAL,value:template or literal}; VARIABLE value={variable_id:ID}; PREDICATE_SYMBOL value={literal:name}|{parameter:ID}; LITERAL value JSON

host.authority: full JSON host declaration/profile/Source authority, preserved verbatim; syntax code does not authenticate it
host.binding: full JSON original binding, preserved verbatim
host.ordered_Gamma: ordered full native formula list; repeated occurrences retained
host.variable_names: finite ordered distinct allowed native names; fresh choice is first allowed unused

invalid_data: DescriptorError(ValueError) with .code; only definite data/scope/port mismatch. Callback exceptions including TimeoutError propagate unchanged. Own finite work/name/depth cutoff returns UNKNOWN; no negative/pruning/theorem authority.
matching: bounded complete binding iteration and forward simultaneous literal matching, not claim complete unifier. A mismatch candidate is only rejected for that literal binding; zero returned matches remains UNKNOWN.

port_bindings.hypotheses: ordered [{port_id,gamma_index,formula}] exactly all descriptor hypotheses, exact original Gamma occurrence
port_bindings.inputs: ordered [{port_id,formula,source:<full JSON provenance>,occupied:bool,fact_accepted:false}] exactly all inputs; occupied does not accept a proof
port_bindings.outputs: ordered subset [{port_id,formula}] of requested literal output receptors; all descriptor outputs still emitted

proposal.UNKNOWN: status UNKNOWN, reason explicit, partial arrays cleared; no partial expansion admitted
proposal.costs: structural exact {descriptor_count,call_frames,primitive_nodes,ordered_input_edges,hypothesis_nodes,root_input_ports,output_ports}; diagnostic work separately not independently exact timing
proposal.dependency_closure: dependency-first [{family_id,descriptor}] for reachable root, full descriptors
proposal.hypothesis_ports: ordered root binding packets plus {source:{node:actual_assumption_nodeID}}; actual assumption node once per root hypothesis occurrence (including unused ports)
proposal.input_ports: ordered root input binding packets; fact_accepted remains false
proposal.primitive_nodes: topological [{id,rule,formula,arguments,ordered_inputs,origin}]; arguments instantiated native values, ordered_inputs refs {node:flatID}|{input:rootPortID}; no hidden facts
proposal.side_condition_checks: ordered [{call_path,index,relation,arguments,satisfied:true}] plus automatic VARIABLE distinctness and EIGEN context checks recorded at relation AUTO_DISTINCT/AUTO_EIGEN
proposal.work: {steps,limit}; producer-local guarded syntax traversal only, no time/semantic evidence

receptors: same port_bindings shape; matching validates EVERY supplied hypothesis/input/output under one complete substitution. General inverse higher-order unification not claimed; declared bounded candidate iterator supplies complete bindings for all four kinds.

scope_side_conditions.DISTINCT: arguments VARIABLE IDs pairwise distinct native names
scope_side_conditions.EIGEN: each EIGEN VARIABLE absent from complete original Gamma plus every external root input dependency formula; no hidden discharge
scope_side_conditions.HOST_PROFILE_MEMBER: [parameter_ID] syntax/signature/name only; native depth/finite membership remains adapter obligation

substitution: exact parameter map. VARIABLE and PREDICATE_SYMBOL are native strings. TERM/FORMULA={formal_names:[distinct placeholder strings],body:native AST}; formal_names arity matches descriptor formal_variables. Free external names limited by mapped allowed_external_free_variables. All binding simultaneous; explicit formula/term abstractions handle intentional bound dependence.
